title: Loviatar's Scourge

sources.title: Willing Whip
markers: | summary = '''Willing Whip''' is a passive feature that grants resistance to Necrotic damage but deals Necrotic damage to every creature nearby.

summary: A mace granting Necrotic resistance. Hits can trigger an area burst of 1d6 Necrotic.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d6 Bludgeoning plus Strength modifier. Simple, one-handed, dippable, 5 ft melee.
fields.Willing Whip: Grants Necrotic resistance. A hit triggers 1d6 Necrotic in a 7 ft radius centred on the creature hit. Allies can take full damage and the wielder takes 0–3 after resistance. Helldusk Armour negates that self-damage. Some damage riders can still hurt the wielder. Multiple damage instances or targets can trigger separate bursts.
fields.Acquisition: Carried by Abdirak. If purchased by barter, it can automatically transfer back to him when he needs it.
fields.Base value: 370 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Concussive Smash: With proficiency, Action once per Short Rest. Melee weapon damage on a hit. A Constitution save prevents Dazed for 2 turns. Use the higher of spell save DC and weapon-action DC +2.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
